subject: [RFC PATCH 4/4] selftests/bpf: add a cgroupfs lock-holder bpf_memcg_ops sample

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch adds a BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) sample to track and enforce policies on tasks holding cgroupfs kernfs locks. The policy, called bpf_memcg_ops, prevents tasks from being inline memory.high enforced if they hold such locks. It does this by tracking the depth of kernfs_rwsem and kernfs_supers_rwsem locks per task using fentry/fexit hooks. Two counters are used to guard against incorrect enforcement. The patch is measured to improve performance on a reproducer, reducing stall times and increasing throughput.
